banner_text: SLOTHSMP IS NOW OPEN! The server is live and ready for players to join!
minecraft_rules: No bullying, hateful language, racial slurs or making fun of people, This is a chill SMP.
No NSFW or inappropriate content anywhere, This also includes avatars or names!
No swearing or profanity, this is a welcoming server.
No spamming messages, emojis or letters, as it can annoy others and clutter chats.
No advertising or self-promotion without permission from a moderator or staff member.
No impersonating other users, moderators, or anyone else.
No users under the age of 9 in the Minecraft server, 13 in the discord server.
Follow instructions given by moderators and admin, as they are there to keep the server safe.
Do not share personal, mental or any information to other users or members, this also includes asking for information.
Respect other players opinions, even if you disagree, keep arguments out of the chat and keep stuff cooled.
No cheating or exploiting in the Minecraft server, we hate fools who do this!
No destroying, breaking or griefing any buildings or homes.
Have fun, be kind, and help create a positive and welcoming community for everyone.
discord_rules: No racial slurs or hateful language should ever be used, and everyone must be treated with respect at all times.
No bullying, harassment, threatening, or making fun of others, whether it’s serious or “just joking.”
No swearing or profanity so the server stays friendly, welcoming, and appropriate for everyone.
No NSFW (inappropriate or adult) content of any kind, including images, videos, or messages.
No sharing links to prevent spam, scams, or unsafe content from being spread.
No users under the age of 13, following Discord’s safety rules and guidelines.
No spamming messages, emojis, or reactions, as it can annoy others and clutter chats.
No advertising or self-promotion without permission from a moderator.
Respect everyone’s opinions, even if you disagree, and keep arguments calm and respectful.
Do not share personal information (yours or someone else’s), such as addresses, phone numbers, or passwords.
Follow instructions given by moderators and admins, as they are there to keep the server safe.
Use channels for their correct purpose and stay on topic in conversations.
No impersonating other users, moderators, or anyone else.
Keep usernames, profile pictures, and statuses appropriate and respectful.
Have fun, be kind, and help create a positive and welcoming community for everyone.
